scope: Fragments for cx-t0 integration, not a runnable board plan

offline_precheck.hypothesis: The pinned private zlib pair, typed OH OpenSLES owner facade, and resident media_jni mapping independently move the four U8 missing-library fatal walls

expect.confirm: Element and BurgerKing have the private alias/provider and pass libz loading; Mindustry has a dladdr-verified U9-SL-OWNER and passes libarc relocation; Chessclock has resident-only U9-MEDIA-OWNER and passes native_init; each target PID loses its specific old fatal chain without additional JNI/runtime or OH audio-backend copies (the explicitly packaged private C zlib provider is not a JNI owner)
expect.refute: Any target lacks its marker, uses a wrong provider or duplicate owner, retains its old fatal chain, or cannot reach its designated checkpoint; no package inventory or generic alive signal counts as a successful repair

required_before_window: source-bound patches rebased onto the actual N10b/U9 build inputs
final built facade, appspawn host and NativeLoader hashes recorded in package.json
artifact_identity on the final candidate and exact OH backend snapshot
full deploy_generation preflight and outer-granted device window

offline_precheck.hypothesis: Restoring the r109c private alias, its unchanged zlib provider and exact-package search prefix moves Element and BurgerKing past missing libz.so

expect.confirm: Each target PID has U9-LIB-ROUTE root=westlake_native, libz.so SONAME resolves to the pinned private alias and libshared_libz.z.so; crc32 resolves to the real zlib provider; the old libz.so fatal chain disappears
expect.refute: Marker absent, wrong namespace/provider/hash, crc32 unresolved, or the target PID still terminates with missing libz.so; do not infer a namespace fix from a package inventory alone

offline_precheck.hypothesis: Opening the full OH OpenSLES backend in default ownership, binding a private facade before libarc relocation and forwarding exact IID pointers moves Mindustry past slCreateEngine

expect.confirm: Mindustry PID has U9-SL-OWNER with dladdr-validated OH engine and private facade; probe counts one OH backend loaded instance, exact queue IID pointer equality and complete five-import coverage; libarc loads without slCreateEngine relocation failure
expect.refute: Wrong-owner or missing-IID binding fails, marker absent, backend duplicated, old app-namespace absolute-path rejection remains, or libarc still cannot resolve slCreateEngine; an exported name alone is not confirmation

offline_precheck.hypothesis: Allowlisting media_jni to the existing registered runtime with resident-only loading moves Chessclock past its framework MediaPlayer static initializer's manifest denial

expect.confirm: Chessclock PID logs U9-MEDIA-OWNER resident-only=1, retains native_init/native_setup registration in the same runtime owner, reaches MediaPlayer native_init and passes the original Ringtone setup point without manifest denial; no additional runtime instance
expect.refute: Absent resident owner, old adapter-manifest error, native_init ULE, extra runtime instance or failure before the Ringtone checkpoint; mapping success is not proof of decoded audio or a lit t20
